name: Serve points won
definition: Points won on the player's own serve / points served

name: Return points won
definition: Points won on the opponent's serve / the opponent's serve points

name: Total points won
definition: Serve plus return points won / all points played

name: Service games held
definition: Service games won / service games played

name: Return games won (breaks)
definition: The opponent's service games broken / the opponent's service games

name: Aces
definition: Aces / serve points

name: Double faults
definition: Double faults / serve points

name: First serves in
definition: First serves in / serve points

name: First-serve points won
definition: Points won when the first serve went in / first serves in

name: Second-serve points won
definition: Points won on the second serve / second-serve points

name: Break points saved
definition: Break points saved / break points faced

name: Break points converted
definition: Break points converted / break-point chances on the opponent's serve

name: Break points faced per service game
definition: Break points faced / service games (a count per game)

name: Tiebreaks won (the tiebreak record)
origin: list: every Stage 0 rate; tiebreak record
definition: Tiebreaks won / tiebreaks played (from the score)

name: Sets won
definition: Sets won / sets completed (from the score)

name: Games won
definition: Games won / games played (from the score)

name: Matches won (the recent win rate)
definition: Matches won / matches played (completed or retired; the player who advanced won)

name: Deciding sets won (the deciding-set record)
definition: Matches won / matches that reached a deciding set

name: Head-to-head record
definition: Earlier meetings of the same two players won by A / earlier meetings

name: Return points won against the first serve
origin: added: Stage 2 (the points edge is made after the serve lands)
definition: The opponent's first serves in that the player won / the opponent's first serves in

name: Return points won against the second serve
origin: added: Stage 2 (the points edge is made after the serve lands)
definition: The opponent's second-serve points that the player won / the opponent's second-serve points

name: Break points won above expectation
origin: added: Stage 2 (the men's break-point record persists weakly beyond luck)
definition: Break points saved and converted above what the match's own serve and return rates predict / break points played

name: Serve against return: points
origin: list: A's serve against B's return
definition: A's serve points won against B's return points won and the reverse; the two expected serve rates through Stage 2's iid model to a match probability

name: Serve against return: games
origin: list: A's serve against B's return
definition: A's holds against B's breaks and the reverse; the expected hold rates turned into point rates and through the iid model

name: Serve against return: break points
origin: list: A's serve against B's return
definition: A's break points saved against B's converted and the reverse; on the log-odds scale (no match model)

name: Serve against return: the serve point built from its parts
origin: added: Stage 2 (the exact split of the points edge)
definition: A's first serves in; A's first- and second-serve points won against B's returns of each; the expected serve rates through the iid model

name: Ranking
definition: log(B's rank) - log(A's rank); unranked as in Stage 1

name: Ranking points
definition: log(1 + A's points) - log(1 + B's points); missing points as 0 as in Stage 1

name: Gap between ranking and Elo
origin: list: gap between ranking and Elo
definition: Each player's Elo minus the Elo their ranking implies; A minus B

name: Games-weighted Elo
definition: Stage 1's surface Elo with each update scaled by the winner's share of the games

name: Points-weighted Elo
definition: The same scaled by the winner's share of the points (games where no box score)

name: Serve rating
origin: list: Stage 3 serve and return ratings
definition: A's serve rating minus B's (Stage 3 pre-match values)

name: Return rating
origin: list: Stage 3 serve and return ratings
definition: A's return rating minus B's (Stage 3 pre-match values)

name: Serve and return ratings through the iid model
origin: list: Stage 3 ratings; A's serve against B's return
definition: The two expected serve rates of Stage 3 through Stage 2's iid model to a match probability (Stage 3's suggestion)

name: Elo's change over 6 months
origin: list: the rating's change over 6 months
definition: Overall Elo now minus 26 weeks ago; A minus B

name: Elo's change over 12 months
origin: list: the rating's change over 12 months
definition: Overall Elo now minus 52 weeks ago; A minus B

name: Age and age squared
definition: (age - 25) and (age - 25) squared; A minus B; two inputs

name: Height
definition: Height in cm; A minus B

name: Left-handed against right-handed
definition: 1 if left-handed else 0; A minus B (non-zero only when one is left-handed and the other right-handed)

name: Record against the opponent's hand
origin: list: left-handed against right-handed (a second reading)
definition: Total points won against players with the opponent's hand minus total points won against everyone; A minus B

name: Matches played (career)
definition: log(1 + earlier matches); A minus B

name: Matches played (last 52 weeks)
definition: log(1 + matches in the last 52 weeks); A minus B

name: Days since the last match
origin: list: days since the last match
definition: log(1 + days between the tournament Mondays of the last match and this one); A minus B

name: Last match ended early
origin: list: whether the last match ended in retirement
definition: Whether the player retired or gave a walkover in their last match; whether their last opponent did; A minus B; two inputs

name: Minutes in the previous match
origin: list: minutes in the previous match
definition: Minutes of the last match played; A minus B

name: Sets in the previous match
origin: list: sets in the previous match
definition: Sets of the last match played; A minus B

name: Minutes over the last 7 days
origin: list: minutes over the last 7 days
definition: Minutes of this event's earlier rounds and of events starting up to 7 days before this one; A minus B

name: Minutes over the last 14 days
origin: list: minutes over the last 14 days
definition: The same up to 14 days before; A minus B

name: Sets over the last 7 days
origin: list: sets over the last 7 days
definition: Sets of this event's earlier rounds and of events starting up to 7 days before this one; A minus B

name: Sets over the last 14 days
origin: list: sets over the last 14 days
definition: The same up to 14 days before; A minus B

name: One of the first matches on this surface this season
origin: list: first matches on this surface this season
definition: 1 if the player has fewer than 3 earlier matches on this surface this season else 0; A minus B

name: Playing in the home country
definition: 1 if the player's country is the tournament's country else 0; A minus B

name: Entry type: qualifier
definition: 1 if the player came through qualifying else 0; A minus B (main draws only)

name: Entry type: lucky loser
definition: 1 if the player lost in qualifying and replaced a withdrawn player else 0; A minus B (main draws only)

name: Entry type: wild card
definition: 1 if the player was given a wild card else 0; A minus B

name: Entry type: protected ranking
definition: 1 if the player entered on a protected (special) ranking after injury else 0; A minus B

name: Match length (best of five)
origin: added: Stage 1 (Elo does not know how long a match is)
definition: The baseline's log-odds times 1 if the match is best of five; an interaction (alone it is not defined)

name: Level played over the last 52 weeks
origin: added: Stage 3 (results from lower levels mislead)
definition: Share of the last 52 weeks' matches played in tour-level main draws; A minus B

name: Big-point play on return (Grand Slam point by point)
origin: added: Stage 2 (the one big-point skill that persists beyond luck)
definition: Importance-weighted minus plain return points won in earlier Grand Slam matches with point-by-point files; shrunk; A minus B
